sql.query: SELECT u.id,u.email,u.fName,u.lName,u.displayName,u.phone,u.jobTitle,u.avatarPath,UPPER(CONCAT(LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(u.fName,''),u.displayName,'U'),1),LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(u.lName,''),''),1))) initials FROM tbl_users u INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenants ut ON ut.userId=u.id AND ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' WHERE u.id=:userId AND u.isActive=1 LIMIT 1
